question: What does S3 Standard storage cost per GB in us-east-1?
visibleText: The documentation provided doesn't state S3 Standard pricing for us-east-1. The closest thing is a cost example in the Live Streaming on AWS with Amazon S3 Implementation Guide, which says Amazon S3 charges $0.023 per Gigabyte (GB) per month for the first 50 Terabytes (TB) stored in the bucket. That example doesn't name a storage class or a Region, so I can't confirm it applies to S3 Standard in us-east-1. Prices also change over time and vary by tier. Check the Amazon S3 pricing page or the AWS Pricing Calculator for the current figure.
